_about: Portfolio Discovery's 'Theme of the week' rotates through these, one per week (weeks start on Monday). 'match' is a case-insensitive pattern tested against each experience's name and one-line essence; a theme is used only when at least 4 experiences with photos match it. Edit, add or reorder freely and redeploy.

themes.title: Arrival & welcome
themes.blurb: How we greet people across every business line, one thread running through the portfolio.

themes.title: Celebrations & milestones
themes.blurb: Birthdays, anniversaries and the moments worth marking, wherever people live, stay, learn or work with Aldar.

themes.title: Families & children
themes.blurb: Experiences designed with the youngest guests, students and residents in mind, and the parents beside them.

themes.title: Known by name
themes.blurb: Recognition that makes people feel remembered: names, preferences and the details that show we were listening.

themes.title: Gifts & keepsakes
themes.blurb: Small, considered objects that carry a moment home and keep it alive long after it has passed.

themes.title: Farewells & handovers
themes.blurb: How we close a chapter well: goodbyes, departures and the handing over of keys.

themes.title: Culture & heritage
themes.blurb: Emirati hospitality, local traditions and the cultural calendar, expressed across the portfolio.

themes.title: Wellbeing & calm
themes.blurb: Moments that slow people down, look after them and leave them feeling better than when they arrived.

themes.title: Surprise & delight
themes.blurb: The unexpected gestures nobody asked for, and the ones people remember and retell.

themes.title: Community & belonging
themes.blurb: Bringing neighbours, colleagues and guests together so a place feels like theirs.
